title: Settings page shows visitorId instead of email
description: The Settings page displays the visitorId (UUID) in the email field instead of the user's actual email. Fix by using session?.user?.email from auth instead of userInfo?.email from the query.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Settings page shows actual user email, not UUID
Email field uses session?.user?.email from authClient.useSession()
Verify in browser - email shows correctly
